session.authority: Codex contract proposal under owner-authorized session slice; not Glenn/Efren/security approval
session.adapter: Proposed application-owned GET /csrf-cookie in Laravel web session/cookie stack; empty 204 response; EncryptCookies and shared MySQL session store. No Sanctum selected or installed.

forgery_policy.token: Mandatory X-XSRF-TOKEN on every unsafe P02 request, including same-origin; URL-decode readable encrypted XSRF-TOKEN cookie once, framework decrypts and compares to session token.
forgery_policy.origin: Additional application guard rejects Sec-Fetch-Site values other than same-origin when present and any supplied Origin not exactly equal to configured browser origin. If Fetch Metadata is absent, require exact Origin or same-origin Referer; otherwise 403 origin_forbidden. No same-site sibling allowance. HTTP loopback needs the same token/origin checks.
forgery_policy.framework_difference: Pinned PreventRequestForgery::handle uses hasValidOrigin OR tokensMatch. A dedicated adapter must enforce token AND origin; originOnly and the default middleware alone cannot satisfy this policy. Do not exempt unsafe routes. Reject _token and X-CSRF-TOKEN alternatives in the JSON adapter to avoid competing token precedence.
forgery_policy.same_origin_missing_token: 419 csrf_mismatch, even with valid credentials. It rejects this attempt only; an earlier uncertain attempt stays unresolved.

production.session_store: Shared MySQL; no replica-local session state

http_loopback.scope: Explicit local development profile only; localhost/127.0.0.1, never deployment
http_loopback.other_attributes: same names, host-only, Path=/, SameSite=Lax; session HttpOnly; same token/origin policy

cookies.rotation: Sign-in, successful MFA, privilege elevation and logout regenerate session ID and CSRF token. Logout invalidates old server session then issues fresh anonymous cookies; bootstrap revalidates disabled/revoked identity. GET /csrf-cookie reissues current CSRF token without unconditional rotation. Read current cookie immediately before each unsafe request; do not cache token in local storage.
cookies.lifetime: Numeric session/MFA lifetimes, attempt limits and recent-proof windows need subsequent security/backend approval. No fixture value approves a runtime default.

session.consumer: Browser credentials: include; Accept: application/json; JSON Content-Type only with a JSON request body; redirect: error. Every result no-store. 204 has no body or Content-Type. No automatic unsafe retry after CSRF/429/network/protocol failure. Refresh/bootstrap can inform next action but never prove an earlier business attempt rejected.
freeze_gates: Glenn reviews exact route/base, cookies, adapter, status/examples and generated consumer usability at this revision
Efren reviews restricted states, provider separation and Leader-authored access contract
Backend/security owner approves dedicated token AND origin adapter before affected contract freeze; numeric security values before runtime enablement
session.deferred: The chapter-context slice extends AuthenticatedSession with chapter details; MFA slices own MFA operations. This slice implements no route, session persistence, authorization or screen.
session.security_scheme_compatibility: Adopt ysp_session as the exact P02 session cookie spelling. Preserve the Stage 0 chapterSession scheme and lookup operations byte-semantically; its older proposed description is historical, with this extension supplying the current session details.

tooling.generator: openapi-typescript 7.13.0, locked in package-lock.json; Node API alphabetize: true; all other options default
tooling.resolution: Swagger Parser 13.1.0 bundle/dereference with resolve.http=false; canonical api-v1.json and external local transport.schema.json definitions; no network schema resolution
tooling.outputs: generated/api.d.ts, routes.ts, session-validation.json and session-examples.ts are deterministic and never hand-edited. Runtime schemas and typed fixtures are generated from the same operations/exchanges, not handwritten transport interfaces.
tooling.compatibility: Generator declares TypeScript ^5.x. Contract compiler pinned to 5.9.3, inheriting frontend strict settings; frontend compiler 6.0.3 also checked by combined verification. Node 24 strip-types executes the validation consumer. No production client/runtime library is added.
runtime_only_constraints: String regex/range and email/date-time formats are runtime Ajv constraints, not TypeScript refinements
TypeScript structural assignment cannot guarantee closed objects for nonliteral variables; runtime rejects extra fields
oneOf exclusivity, array uniqueness/minimums and header value patterns require runtime validation
Browser Set-Cookie is not script-readable; synthetic fixtures check cookie attributes, not actual browser/backend security

SessionSnapshot.description: Closed state union. Restricted states disclose no user/chapter choices/context, duties, permissions, provider destinations or operation data. Disabled, expired and revoked sessions bootstrap as signed_out; reasons are deliberately indistinguishable.

ChallengeId.description: Opaque current identity AND server-session binding, distinct from operation IDs; never an account selector or authority token.

UtcInstant.description: UTC DATETIME(6) wire instant, six fractional digits and Z. Enable date-time format assertion in validators. Display in Asia/Manila while retaining the UTC value; deadlines use elapsed time (48 hours is 172800 seconds), never a local calendar-day substitution. JavaScript Date is only millisecond-precise: it may format a display, but retain the original six-place string for identity, exact comparison and fingerprinting.

AuthenticatedSession.description: P02 authenticated session core. The chapter-context slice extends this same schema with chapter choices/current authority. Absence of chapter fields here grants no chapter access. Required MFA is derived from current server authority, never client input.

Id.description: Positive BIGINT UNSIGNED ID as exact base-10 text, range 1?18446744073709551615, without leading zeros. Never convert to JavaScript Number or PHP float. Pattern enforces the storage range; the server also enforces scoped reference existence and authorization. Human document references and public operation IDs are distinct types.

ProviderDestination.description: Independently authorized provisioning destination, not a chapter membership, duty or permission. No operational access follows from it. Other provider surfaces await their owning contracts.

SignInRequest.description: Individual credentials only. Never log/echo/store the password in client persistence. Successful exchange creates no business record, operation ID, replay key or chapter context before required MFA.
